'''2012 Match Play Championship Day 1 Scott Lingrell LS Kashyyyk (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Scott Lingrell]] at [[2012 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Kashyyyk (V)|VB5-L-kashyyyk-pre.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
